### Simple Obedience
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-devotional-11-or-11-or-03-1230866.html
Passage: Acts 9:15
Points:
- Saul was an aggressive persecutor of the church, making believers understandably suspicious of him.
- Despite his hesitation, Ananias chose simple obedience to the Lord's instructions.
- God selected an ordinary believer rather than a prominent apostle to restore and disciple Saul.
- Quiet servants working faithfully behind the scenes have a lasting impact in God's kingdom.

### A Chosen Instrument
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-september-12-2020.html
Passage: Acts 9:15-16
Points:
- Ananias struggled to understand how a violent opponent of the faith could become an ambassador for Christ.
- God revealed that Saul was His chosen vessel and showed that his mission would include extensive suffering.
- Hardship serves as God's classroom for shaping character, humility, and deeper grace.
- Saul's future trials prepared him to be an effective instrument of mercy to a hurting world.
